issues.issue: Two survey areas, an inferred seam or a constant raster cannot stand in for four operational GeoDAWN blocks.
issues.resolution: Four blocks are DERIVED from the official figure (scripts/derive_acquisition_blocks.py) and audited against the published line-km (per-block +0.8 %, +3.4 %, -2.1 %, +1.1 %; total +1.2 %). An independent digitization from the figure latitude ticks (40.00, 38.99, 38.08 N) agrees within ~5 km (northern seam) and ~1-2 km (southern seams). Official coordinates are NOT published; membership within ~2 km of a seam is ambiguous (tie lines overlap). Official flight-number mapping needs the S3-hosted profile archives (anonymous GET 403).

issues.resolution: Area1 priority implemented and regression-tested.

issues.issue: The inherited road mirror is clipped tightly to (-120.0024,37.3641,-116.1415,40.7247). A 20 km seed grid does not recover missing external road geometries.
issues.resolution: Official whole-county Census run succeeded in CI (32 counties, 1,141,630 seed pixels, complete_county_check=true; raster SHA matches data/external/audit_sources/tiger_road_receipt.json). Root cause of the earlier CI failure: strict CRS.equals on the ESRI WKT (axis order), fixed with an authority-code check.

issues.issue: Masked known predictions could earn TP credit on adjacent new truth; catalogue truth masking was inconsistent.
issues.resolution: Both exact and binary DTI now mask predictions and truth regardless of legacy flag. Adjacent-new-truth and randomized parity tests pass.

issues.issue: Re-thinning/re-ranking binary submissions, zero-budget -0 slicing and arbitrary zero backfill invalidated inherited promotion claims.
issues.resolution: True four-arm refitting, as-emitted historical diagnostics, deterministic positive-only top budgets and explicit current-best reconstruction veto.

issues.issue: Zero-padded quadrants or zeroing catalogue pixels before NMS could create artificial boundary/flank ridges.
issues.resolution: Complete predicted halos and valid-support erosion; catalogue exclusion only after NMS; boundary tests pass.

issues.issue: An exact-candidate torus shift produced a single-class held-out fold, for which AUC is undefined.
issues.resolution: Geometry/cohort support only determines retry; no statistic-based exclusion. Every rejected draw is recorded; retries bounded; 99 valid shifts required. Shift inference is conditional and diagnostic, not an exact spatial null. Grouped primary remains unchanged.

issues.issue: Original H19 OOF caches and source-to-artifact reconstruction are unavailable.
issues.resolution: Original H19 OOF caches remain unavailable, so no certified win over the original 0.21413/0.08667 is claimed. Paired comparisons use the SAME as-emitted harness for baseline and candidate (shared leak cancels); see IR-H19-HARNESS-LEAK.

issues.issue: H19 comments call four heavily shared-input lines independent and contain old budget-only descriptions alongside changed weight code.
issues.resolution: Actual reviewed coefficients and shared terrain inputs documented; measured Jaccard .777234. Score differences and code coefficients are not causal ablations.

issues.issue: Annular coherence can respond to intrusion rims, erosion and locally tangent sharp contacts; it is not unique to ring faults.
issues.resolution: Synthetic specificity-limit test added; first feature/run retained unchanged. No discovery or angular-coverage correction is silently claimed after observing folds.

issues.issue: The initial preregistration fixes transforms/splits/budget/gates but does not enumerate every numeric HGB/residualizer setting.
issues.resolution: Settings were fixed in implementation before first fit and no outer-fold search occurred; preregistration completeness is not overstated or retroactively rewritten.

issues.issue: Owner-mirror integrity does not independently authenticate organizer bytes or every original band alias.
issues.resolution: Full hashes/provenance caveat retained; ambiguous tc/earthquake aliases excluded. Do not claim all physical semantics independently verified.

issues.issue: Official metadata has <class 'str'> placeholders, a Winnemucca title for a full-survey extent, and 151799 line-km versus 149030 in the contractor report.
issues.resolution: Different accounting is possible but unverified; no boundaries or calibration inferred from the discrepancies.

issues.resolution: Strict writer (finite [0,1] inside, NaN or zeros outside, template profile). Forensics over 148 owner rasters (evidence/format_forensics.json): none has an in-footprint value outside [0,1]; only three early 5GEMSDOE files have NaN inside; blank-score files are format-identical to scored ones; 12GEMSDOE scored identically with both outside conventions. The cause of the original portal message is NOT established.

issues.issue: The legacy promotion gate requires the DENSE catalogue holdout (truth density ~1.18 % of cells) to improve. The blind-lattice calibration puts hidden truth at ~0.24 %. For the one independent pair with known scores (h25 -> h28) the harness dense ratio was 0.77 (wrong sign) while the owner-reported score rose 44 %; the sparse ratio was 1.08 (right sign, conservative).
issues.resolution: Emission/thinning is judged on the density-matched sparse simulation first, with the legacy gate reported unchanged. A candidate that fails only the dense criterion is labelled owner_decision_required, never auto-promoted.

issues.issue: H19 emissions masked ALL catalogue pixels, including pixels the holdout withholds, so as-emitted holdout DTI is inflated and not comparable with the original OOF numbers.
issues.resolution: Only paired comparisons (same harness, same leak) are used for decisions; absolute DTI is never quoted as a forecast.

issues.issue: H28 0.1839 and the 13GEMSDOE lattice 0.0904 appear only in the 2026-10-02 brief; the older GEMSDOE21 snapshot shows them blank. The truth-density calibration and the dotting natural experiment rest on them.

issues.issue: Leaderboard rows #26 smrtdoog5 (0.1922) and #28 SDCF9 (0.1894) equal the owner-reported H19-5/H19-4 scores; ownership is unverified. The rules allow three submissions per week per entity and one final submission per entity.

issues.issue: Pixel-level forensics on the newly owner-reported 2026-10-25 live submissions revealed why GVC1 (0.14876 holdout -> 0.0859 live) and GEMSDOE25 H66-MGD (0.0742 live) collapsed relative to GEMSDOE27 H29-CELF (0.2190 live): training with a >=900 m negative dead zone and refitting in-sample on 100% of labels.tif at Stage 5 caused smooth 1.5-2.5 km geophysical/hydrothermal features to memorize all 3,199 training fault traces, dumping 70.4% (GVC1) and 69.6% (H66-MGD) of emitted dots into 200-900 m catalogue aprons and starving >2 km far-field discovery (8.5% and 3.0%, vs 49.2% in H33-B2 and 44.3% in H29-CELF). SegmentHoldout(buffer_px=15) has min(d_vis)=16.0 px inside fold['valid'], making it blind to Stage-5 in-sample 200-900 m apron memorization.
issues.resolution: Resolved in H24-DPRF1 (src/gems/dprf1.py, scripts/run_dprf1_lane.py) via stratified d_vis>=3.0 px negative training (+0.00717 paired holdout gain, 4/4 folds won over d_vis>=9.0 px) and Dual-Partition Stitched-OOF (Quadrant + Rotated45 Diamond) + Apron Quantile Debiasing, restoring 52.3% >2 km far-field coverage (22.3% in 200-900 m apron) and passing all 54 competing method rasters (max 3-px overlap 0.5578 <= 0.70).

issues.issue: 2026-10-25 H24-GVC1 (HOLDOUT-DTI 0.14876, overlap-stopped at 0.7682) received an owner-reported public score of 0.0859 in sibling ledgers. Pixel forensics proved its full-footprint deployment fitted in-sample on train_mask=fp with neg_mask=(EDT(~catalogue)>=9 px) and global radial -log1p(EDT) thermal distance fields, dumping 45.8% of dots into 2<d_cat<=5 px and 86.0% into d_cat<=15 px while leaving only 4.1% in deep concealed terrain (d_cat>30 px vs 35.8% in GEMSDOE32 H33-2-B2). SegmentHoldout (15 px collar) could not observe the <15 px halo.
issues.resolution: Resolved independently in 2026-10-26 H24-TRSG1 via (1) 20% close-flank negatives (4<=d_vis<9 px) + 80% far negatives (>=9 px), (2) compact local DoG thermal kernels (zero global EDT), (3) 100% out-of-fold Dual-Partition Stitched-OOF deployment (0.5*Quadrant_OOF + 0.5*Rotated45_OOF), and (4) Two-Regime Concealed-Basin (26%) + Range-Front (74%) allocation, reducing 2<d_cat<=5 px halo to 18.4% and raising d_cat>30 px discovery to 32.0% while passing 137-raster novelty (max overlap 0.6293 <= 0.70; <=0.6622 vs DPRF1/TNR1/CRP1/CUP1) and C2ST (AUC 0.4727).
